real_property_downloads.description: Data includes property information like owner name, mailing address and legal descriptions, neighborhood information, permit information and deed information.

Residential building information, information of income producing properties including occupancy rates and operating income, general data and characteristics  of the building, extra features, structural elements of the property, land use acreage and land units and agricultural and timber land information.
Lists the jurisdictions and exemptions associated with an account, taxing district percent rates and the tax rates.

Reference for all Appraisal Codes, neighbourhood numbers adjustment, permit codes and status, extra features use codes, real property jurisdictions and jurisdiction types, land influence factors, agent roles and conclusion codes to reflect the results of a hearing.
